entities.text: Pratik Majumdar vs The State Of Assam And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
By way of filing this application under Section 528/438/442 of BNSS, 2023, the accused/petitioner is assailing the order dated 19.08.2024 whereby the learned Judicial Magistrate,
First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati issued Non-Bailable Warrant of Arrest against the accused/petitioner in connection with CR Case No.3629/2022.
3.

entities.text:
Judicial Magistrate,
First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It appears that on 31.05.2022, the respondent No.2 filed a complaint against the accused/petitioner under Section 138/142 of the N.I. Act and under Section 420 of the IPC before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati thereby claiming for releasing of an amount of Rs.10,00,000/- against dishonour of a cheque bearing No.000012 dated 04.04.2022.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In connection with the aforesaid complaint, in view of the non-appearance of the accused/petitioner,
the Criminal Court vide the order dated 19.08.2024 issued NBWA against the accused/petitioner through the jurisdictional Commissioner of Police against which the instant Criminal Petition has been filed.

4. Ms. A. G. Choudhury, learned counsel for the accused/petitioner submits that the accused/petitioner is ready and willing to appear on the next date fixed before the Criminal Court and further cooperate in the Page No.# 3/3 trial.

5. In view of the aforesaid endorsement made by the learned counsel for the accused/petitioner, this Court deems it fit to dispose of the instant Criminal Petition at the motion stage itself before issuing notice to the informant by directing the accused/petitioner to appear before the Judicial Magistrate,
First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati, Assam on 21.10.2024 and if the accused/petitioner appears on the said date, the NBWA issued against the accused/petitioner shall be kept in abeyance.

entities.text:
Judicial Magistrate,
First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati, Assam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. It is needless to clarify that in the event of the accused/petitioner does not cooperate with the trial, the Trial Court is at liberty to proceed against the accused/petitioner in accordance with law.
7. With the above observation and direction, the instant Criminal Petition stands disposed of.
